## Summary

Describe the change and link the related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] NinjaScript compiles in the supported NinjaTrader 8 environment, or compilation limitations are explained.
- [ ] Tested in historical data, Playback, or Sim101 as appropriate; no live account was used for testing.
- [ ] Screenshots or relevant Output/Log excerpts are attached when behavior changes.
- [ ] Instrument, bar type/value, Trading Hours template, and time zone used for testing are listed when relevant.

## Safety review

- [ ] Automatic trading remains disabled by default.
- [ ] No account, contract, position, daily loss, maximum loss, emergency stop, or trade-management guard was weakened unintentionally.
- [ ] ET conversion and daylight-saving behavior are unchanged or explicitly tested.
- [ ] No credentials, account identifiers, personal data, logs, exports, or proprietary data are included.

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation and tests are updated as needed.
- [ ] The diff contains only changes relevant to this PR.
